body:
Universal Computation Limit Mapper. Studies the maximum computation possible under physical limits involving energy, entropy, time, and causality.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 21 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Computational Reality and the Limits of Computing". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: theoretically plausible. Physical limits on computation are real theory (Bremermann, Margolus-Levitin, Landauer); mapping them universally is ongoing.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Universal Computation Limit Mapper - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Studies the maximum computation possible under physical limits involving energy, entropy, time, and causality.
body:
Known science foundations of Universal Computation Limit Mapper.

Bremermann's limit (~1e50 ops/s/kg), Margolus-Levitin (6e33 ops/s/J), and Landauer (kT ln 2) bound computation. Lloyd's ultimate laptop explores limits. A universal mapper — every substrate, every limit — is the research frontier.

Key quantity check (Margolus-Levitin ops per joule / current supercomputer ops per joule): computed ratio 6e+23 against the reference value, relative error 1.118e-16, within the stated tolerance of 0.4. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Universal Computation Limit Mapper.

Limits are often unachievable. New physics could shift bounds. Mapping is theoretical.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 23.78 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is ML limit vs supercomputer at 23.78 orders of magnitude (ML limit larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
